scripts.generate: python3 scripts/generate_platform_sdk.py && openapi-typescript apps/studio/lib/openapi.json -o packages/typescript-sdk/src/schema.ts --default-non-nullable false
scripts.build: npm run build -w @foundry/sdk && npm run build -w @foundry/react && npm run build -w @foundry/sdk-example
scripts.format: prettier --write packages/{typescript-sdk,react-sdk}/src apps/sdk-example/{src,app,tests} apps/sdk-example/*.ts tests/sdk scripts/*.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages/{typescript-sdk,react-sdk}/src apps/sdk-example/{src,app,tests} apps/sdk-example/*.ts tests/sdk scripts/*.mjs
